description: Implement Google auth flow and clickable dashboard cards with filtering/sorting on detail pages
steps: Update KpiCard component to accept optional href prop and wrap in Next.js Link when provided
Update DashboardOverview to pass href to each KpiCard (Total PnL -> /metrics, Active Accounts -> /accounts, Active Groups -> /groups, Total Trades -> /metrics)
Update landing page signIn call to include callbackUrl: /dashboard
Add filtering and sorting controls to accounts page
Add filtering and sorting controls to groups page
acceptance_criteria: KpiCard accepts href prop and renders as clickable link when provided
Dashboard cards navigate to correct detail pages
Landing page signIn redirects to /dashboard after Google auth
Login page signIn redirects to /dashboard after Google auth
Accounts page has sorting (by name, balance, status, platform) and filtering (by status, platform)
Groups page has sorting (by name, member count, status, activity) and filtering (by status)
